notes.title: 1.0.0.2 Patch Fix
notes.content:
- Added Continue Run Confirmation
"No" = Return to Hub
"Yes" = Continue run where you left off

Sometimes when you press play it just loads the main menu level again, but if you press play again
the issue would be resolved and you would load a level correctly, but that is not the case for a user
called trungledorph, no matter how many times he presses the play he keeps coming back to the main menu, i've got no idea why or how this happens currently, so as a quick fix i added this continue run confirmation, the only way the issue i described will happen with this confirmation is if you press "Yes"
it will try to load level that is saved from save file and sometimes the issue would happen, if that happens 
press "No" it will just open the hub level without getting any references and will work 100% of the time

Hello there, it has been 28 days since any news so here's some information about the next update.

The next update is called "God's Armaments" which will be adding 11 entirely new weapons,
2 remastered weapons and also overhauling all the variants, stats and attachments.

The new pistol in the video is the new starter gun, old one (AHN.9x19) 
is now removed from the game, now there's 10 more weapons to be worked on left and then the 2 remastered weapons, there will be no more weapon removals except for this one.

You can also see in the video there are new demon models as well, much better looking models and
actually looks like a demon compared to the old zombie models.

For estimation of when the update's gonna drop its probably not next month, could be early to mid November in the best case scenario since there's a ton of work to do.

While you guys wait for the update I'm gonna be dropping more videos on the other new guns

This update allows you to change the difficulty of the Roguelite mode, Gear Cards that will always save
like blood crystals and drop as loot giving you an alternative instead of buying the crates, but not completely making the weapon crates useless, and also the melee crate in Placid Isle & Tranquil Den has been replaced by the new "Sigma Cache" that gives you a weapon in the exotic-mythical tiers and also a melee weapon.

I added the Sigma Cache because i felt like playing for 30-40 minutes and only having two mythical weapons by then isn't that great, so i added these sigma caches instead to increase the chances of having more mythical weapons,

these features were planned for the next major update but i feel like these things are very strong
on its own and changes the gameplay in a very positive way so why wait until the next major update.

notes.title: S.E.C.U. - ACT 2 "Malignant Woodlands" Teaser
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lvgzyh-somA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










ACT 2 Will feature the same amount of levels as ACT 1

Level List :
- Bleak Thicket (Finished)
- Austere Grove (Finished)
- Slumbering Springs (Finished)
- Deluged Strand (Finished)
- Moist Husk (Unfinished)
- Placid Isle (Unfinished)
- Envenomed Ascent (Unfinished)

And here's a list of things that are done
- New "The Guardian" Death & Spawn Animation
- New Poisonous Demon Type
- Arenas Map "Riled Ravine"
- Improved Special Demon Explosion
- Fixed Bug Where Trees Didn't Have Collision In Flooded Ravine
- Added Distance Culling To ACT 1 And New ACT 2 Levels
- Overhauled "The Guardian" ACT 1 Fight
- Fixed Bug Where Fast Hands Perk Would Not Spawn In Rougelite Mode
- Improved "Derelict Arena" Environment
- Slight Improvement To "Fractured Gorge" Level
- Increased Sacrifice Blood Crystals Amount To 20 Instead Of 10

The ACT 2 Special Demon type pukes poison at you instead of exploding on death,
with doubled health, increased movement speed and with the ACT 2 Levels much more 
smaller/tighter it is a much harder experience compared to ACT 1. I am very excited
for you guys to try out the next update, It's about around halfway done and
the update will be called "Malignant Corruption", it may or may not release this month

And there is also other news, previously i have promised 6 Acts to the final release of S.E.C.U.
But that plan was made when there was only 3 levels excluding boss arena for each Acts,
Now it's double that and i think it would be best if there were only 3 Acts instead of 6 now,
3 Acts is the perfect length for the current balancing and pacing right now in S.E.C.U. 

But in saying that, the final Act, ACT 3 is planned to be longer in length and to feature more than one boss "Guardian"

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello! 

so if you've been seeing the #devlogs channel on the discord server you'll know that i'm
remaking horde mode and infestation, i'm basically remaking all the maps with improved layouts,
detail and gameplay improvements.


Here's the first infestation level i'm working on
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788283/aea2340844feda4024a9484e676b9c741d64abd3.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788283/4afcbce7c4fe41eec8e08f8df09d951fc90e3561.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788283/56a9e475389698e1a8f53c22ac2ec7dc17ec416b.png[/img]

And here's the first person view for scale reference 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788283/232964501b68525c70b29b61a44c29789c09098e.png[/img]

Here's also the 2nd infestation level still in blockout phase
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42788283/1a3254d56e33b29da6617c0a013663da628511dc.png[/img]

keep in mind that these are still not done, quite a lot to do left.

So basically the new infestation areas are much more bigger, detailed with set pieces and verticality,
there's also new gameplay features added to infestation that i will be revealing once they are done.

the boss arenas will be much more detailed in layout as well, plus safehouse and trial redesign,
There may or may not be a major update this April.

Now you may be asking why am i making the decision to remake all the levels,
well short answer is because they are shit, the horde mode levels are just one big square with
different themes, and infestation levels are just long ass straight uninterrupted hallways, the boss arenas are also just boxes, i don't want that, i want the levels to be more complex and detailed, makes it more fun as well.

That is all for now, thanks for sticking by and supporting S.E.C.U.! i will be doing these update posts
more frequently as well from now on.

Join the discord for more news : https://discord.gg/ZDQGU3fs5Q
